characteristics: other sources cite shorter ~12-16km for base Tor variants), 8 ready-to-fire missiles, fully mobile/autonomous operation
Strength: Fast reaction time; designed specifically for point defense of maneuver units, not just fixed sites
Limitation: Short range means point-defense only; specification figures vary notably between sources (worth flagging as a live discrepancy rather than picking one silently)
Estimated quantity available: Fielded numbers not fully disclosed
employment_notes: Positioned as short-range protection for maneuver forces and rear-area sites against drones, PGMs and low-flying aircraft — the Russian-side functional counterpart to Ukraine's Gepard in the layered air defense comparison
contrast_vs_traditional: Tor-M2 was built as short-range point defense against manned aircraft and cruise missiles. Most of its actual engagements now are against slow, cheap FPVs and Shahed-family drones — a multi-hundred-thousand-dollar interceptor fired at a target costing a few tens of thousands of dollars, the same cost-asymmetry inversion doctrine.md notes for HIMARS-vs-FPV fires, just running in the opposite direction here.
